sentence_text: (i) withhold information under this section only if –

proposals.quote: withhold information under this section only if –
proposals.condition: the agency reasonably foresees harm to an interest protected by an exemption, or disclosure is prohibited by law
proposals.subject: withholding
proposals.allowed_example: The agency withholds a record after recording a foreseeable-harm finding, or because disclosure is prohibited by law.
proposals.forbidden_example: The agency withholds a record because an exemption could apply, with no harm finding and no legal prohibition.
